# Repository instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and preserve existing user changes.
Pantry Core owns and executes all hosted GitHub Actions, reusable lanes, source pinning, signing and publication. Private source repositories remain source-only; never route execution back into Workspace Actions.
Keep public automation recipes separate from authenticated, exact-commit private source checkouts. Preserve canonical signatures, frozen Bootstrap anchors, provenance and publication leases. Never commit private source, credentials, signer material or decrypted handoff contents to this repository.
